title: Refactor Coda Desktop UI to Use Semio-Elements UI
description: Refactor the coda desktop UI completely to only use semio-elements/ui components. Replace all custom inline components in renderer.tsx with their semio-elements/ui equivalents.
summary: Replaced the bespoke ontology and validation tree widgets in the coda desktop renderer with semio-elements Tree/TreeItem rendering, preserved truth/witness/cardinality semantics through exported descriptors, added regression coverage in the existing semio Vitest file, and verified both vitest and the coda renderer build pass.
